dependencies.minimal:
sudo apt-get update &&
sudo apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl redis-tools
dependencies.standard:
sudo apt-get update &&
sudo apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl redis-tools libnuma1 libuuid1

scope: All four release packages: displayed download, checksum, extraction and version commands. Both native-architecture variants: loopback kernel TCP/io_uring startup, displayed Redis commands, and graceful restart. No SPDK device, DPDK networking, performance, or crash test.

packages.commands:
curl -fLO --retry 3 https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.1/lavik-v0.1.0-beta.1-linux-aarch64-minimal.tar.gz &&
curl -fLO --retry 3 https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.1/lavik-v0.1.0-beta.1-linux-aarch64-minimal.tar.gz.sha256 &&
sha256sum -c lavik-v0.1.0-beta.1-linux-aarch64-minimal.tar.gz.sha256 &&
tar -xzf lavik-v0.1.0-beta.1-linux-aarch64-minimal.tar.gz &&
cd lavik-v0.1.0-beta.1-linux-aarch64-minimal &&
./lavik --version
